full_details.title: Pixel-Perfect Elementor Page Fix
full_details.full_description:
I have three WordPress pages already built in Elementor that must mirror my Figma layouts down to the last pixel. The previous freelancer left a few nagging issues—unexpected line breaks, mis-aligned sections and other small inconsistencies that keep the pages from looking exactly like the design. 

The task is straightforward: jump into the existing Elementor setup, correct those visual glitches and make sure each page is fully responsive so the desktop and mobile views stay identical to Figma. I’ll share the Figma links and WordPress credentials as soon as we start.

Timing is critical. I need the fixes completed and ready for a final check within one hour of acceptance.

Acceptance criteria:
• All three pages match the Figma design 100 % on desktop, tablet and mobile  
• No stray line breaks, spacing gaps or alignment issues remain  
• Changes are made only with Elementor (no hard-coded CSS unless absolutely necessary and documented)

If you’ve done rapid-fire, pixel-perfect Elementor work before and can jump on this immediately, let’s get it done.
